variable_value: Index of differenced movement within the video (sampled at 30Hz).
Participant identifier within the dyad, relative to their location within the frame ("right" or "left")
Target participant's movement, as quantified by the proportion of pixels changed (relative to all pixels in the target participant's half of the frame) from the previous frame

Dyad and conversation identifier: four-digit dyad identifier (starting at 1000), communication medium condition (FF as face-to-face; ZT as videoconference lab; ZR as videoconference remote), conversation number within the dyad (1-3), conversation type (aff as affiliative; arg as argumentative; coop as cooperative task-based), with underscore separator. May also include "Video" and/or "Trim(med)" after the dyad conversation identifier.
